notes.title: Demo next week
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It’s finally time to announce that, after years of work, you’ll get to play a project that has grown into the polished product it is today: the Demo is about to be released![/p][p]Starting [b]October 1st[/b], and for an entire month, you’ll be able to explore its elegant, well-crafted building features and bring all your ideas to life. Yes, less than a week to go![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/ec5cd6446ca95b7fbad09f760baf7065bf5ff6cc.png"][/img][/p][p]My vision has always been to create a game where building feels as natural as moving blocks in real life, where scaling, rotating, and reshaping items is intuitive and fun. Soon, you’ll get to see for yourself whether that goal was reached.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/39e04cb0d8948aac0059081ab6473c22a85c8f27.png"][/img][/p][p]You’ll have around 100 objects at your disposal for crafting beautiful cafés. But that’s just the beginning, you’ll also have a variety of basic shapes you can use however you like to build whatever you imagine.[/p][p]And the best part? After creating your perfect scene and adjusting the lighting to your taste, you’ll be able to snap photos and share them with the community.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/dd653ab522d8b4f5bb19f8361507ab48184d7c9b.png"][/img][/p][p]Playtesters have already had a lot of fun experimenting (and yes, breaking the game!), and I’ve had just as much fun fixing all the bugs they found. Now I can’t wait to see what you create, hear your feedback, and learn your ideas for making this experience even better.[/p][p]We’ll see you on [b]October 1st[/b]! If you’re excited about Block Block Block, don’t forget to:[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375490/Block_Block_Block/"][b]Wishlist the game on Steam[/b][/url][/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/vvJx4D79UR"][b]Join the community on Discord[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for following along on this journey![/p][p]— [b]Aender Lara[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog - Lights and more
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It’s been a little while since the last update, but we’ve got a lot of exciting things to share. We recently hit [b]4500 wishlists[/b] (thank you!), opened a [b]Discord server[/b], and began testing builds directly on Steam. Slowly but sure, everything is coming together.[/p][p]Behind the scenes, we’ve made some less flashy but important improvements, like better [b]undo/redo history[/b], [b]smaller save files[/b], and [b]smarter background systems[/b]. But today’s devlog is all about the more [b]visually fun and game-changing additions[/b] from the past few months:: [/p][h1]Horizontal Offset[/h1][p]
[b]Easier plank placement on the edges of your pirate ship[/b]

You can now offset items horizontally, not just vertically. This means you can fine-tune placement in all directions; ideal for things like floating planks over tables or creative builds that need a little push out of their center.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/12a4736a09f74c3ba17b2402e4bf68d3ba3a331d.gif"][/img][/p][h1]Deform Side Variant[/h1][p]
[b]Stretch walls with more control (and less stress)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Deformable items now support one-sided editing, thanks to the horizontal offset system. Grab just one side, and we’ll handle the math in the background to make sure the item still behaves nicely with its parent object.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/22dafa39ef38a4cb66c2db8d3e02fef56c89f64c.gif"][/img][/p][h1]New Settings Options[/h1][p]
[b]More accessibility and better performance control[/b]

The settings menu is growing, with new options like [b]UI scaling[/b], [b]graphics toggles[/b], and [b]audio settings[/b]. Whether you’re tuning for performance or customizing your experience, more tools are now at your fingertips. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/3ba029b80151b3783d905ef5211ead3154641e18.png"][/img][/p][h1]💡 Lights![/h1][p]
[b]Now supporting three different types of lights[/b][/p][p]The biggest visual update: [b]lighting controls[/b] are here! You can now use: [/p][list][*][p][b]Ambient Light (Sky Light):[/b] Adjusts the overall tone of the room and includes fog controls for atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/5169f0ff5f899e64c67f5a4a0ff62768c2ef82b4.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Directional Light:[/b] Simulates sunlight or light from a set direction, with optional shadows![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/72661b58e2ab7a70f0f737f938fbcb69b68f57c1.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Item Lights:[/b] Some items like screens or lamps now emit light (via point lights), adding warmth and realism to your builds.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324715/ee436328656ade9ecb53485e7aa59f0e2f7e62b9.gif"][/img][/p][p]I hope you’ve enjoyed this little peek into the development journey. If you're excited about [i]Block Block Block[/i], don’t forget to:[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375490/Block_Block_Block/"][b]Wishlist the game on Steam[/b][/url][/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/vvJx4D79UR"][b]Join the community on Discord[/b][/url][/p][p]Thanks for following along![/p][p]— [b]Aender Lara[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog - Studio Mode and New Beginnings
notes.content:
Happy New Year, everyone! 🎉

It’s been a month since [b]Block Block Block[/b] launched its Steam page, and I’m incredible grateful for all the support so far. Development has been moving forward steadily—though as always, for every bug fixed, a few new ones seem to sneak in!

This past month, I’ve been focused on a new feature I’m excited to share: the Studio Section.

[h1]Introducing Studio Mode[/h1]

The Studio Section lets you set up camera parameters to capture your dioramas in style. With a clean and intuitive UI designed to feel like operating a real camera lens, you can:

[b]Adjust angles, zoom, and other things effortlessly.[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45324715/71e57fac0ed6d22b6134e35038f70a34a149cc4b.gif[/img]

[b]Snap pictures of your creations with a single button.[/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45324715/e2a5adb35f06ac1307e71e63a6721a73e909708a.gif[/img]

Once you’ve captured your masterpiece, head to the Gallery, where you can manage your photos and relive your favorite builds.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45324715/fa59108eb53678b92e395075339bce3dd332776e.gif[/img]

[h1]New Items![/h1]

In addition to Studio Mode, I’ve also added some brand-new items for you to stack, customize, and decorate with.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45324715/0eb230b68fb7f1cd5a43ea928938658738270f7b.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for being part of this journey. If you’re as excited as I am about [b]Block Block Block[/b], make sure you add it to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375490/Block_Block_Block/][b]your wishlist on Steam[/b][/url]—it helps a ton and means the world to me.

Here’s to a creative and block-filled year ahead!

Cheers,

Aender Lara

notes.title: The Beginning of Block Block Block
notes.content:
Hello world! I’m Aender Lara, a game developer originally from Venezuela, now living in Uruguay. Today, I’m excited o share a first look at my passion project, Block Block Block! This cozy builder game has been crafted in my free time over the past few years, and it’s been an incredible journey bringing it to life.

[b]About the Game[/b]

Block Block Block is a game where you stack wooden blocks to create dioramas—anything from outdoor scenes to intricate interiors. Inspired by playing with my son’s wooden toys and the desire to create something intuitive for illustrators and decorators, the game is all about creativity, relaxation, and the joy of building without limits.

[previewyoutube=HDzMh8IeWQw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Team[/b]

While I’ve been developing the game mostly solo, I’ve had invaluable help from two amazing collaborators:

Nathasha Padron ([url=https://links.muakata.com/]@muakata[/url] on social media), who has contributed her artistic talents to shape the game’s charming visuals.

Gustavo Lara, who’s working on the music to give Block Bloc Block its warm, soothing vibe.

[b]What’s Left To Do?[/b]

We’re getting closer to the 1.0 release, but there’s still work to be done! Here’s what we’re focusing on:

[list]
[*] Adding a few more features to enhance the building experience.
[*] Expanding the library of items to give you even more creative options.
[*] Polishing every corner of the game to make it feel just right.
[/list]

[b]What You Can Do in the Game[/b]

In Block Block Block, you can:

[list]
[*] Build your dream scenes with multiple customizable spaces.
[*] Stack and arrange blocks with realistic interactions that feel like real-life wooden toys.
[*] Move, rotate, and scale items, or even reshape and repaint them.
[*] Create both cozy interiors and imaginative outdoor landscapes.
[/list]

[b]What Do You Think?[/b]

I’d love to hear from you! What would you like to see in Block Block Block? Do you have questions about the game ideas for items and features? Drop your thoughts in the comments, and let’s make this game together.

Thank you for joining me on this journey—I can’t wait to share more updates soon! And if you haven't already, consider adding our game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375490/Block_Block_Block/]wishlist[/url].♥️

Stay creative,
Aender Lara
